_contextLimitsNote: ZCode does not store model context window sizes on disk, so the panel computes the percentage against these numbers. The values are evidence-based: each model's entry is the largest prompt that model has carried successfully in this ZCode install, rounded up, because a request that succeeded proves the window is at least that big. Set the exact window here when you know it; the panel flags the reading as 'full' if an observed request ever exceeds the number you set.
_pricingNote: Rates are USD per 1M tokens. They ship empty so the panel never shows a made-up cost. Fill in your provider's real rates (input, output, optional cacheRead) and the panel shows an estimated spend. Leave a model out and its cost metric is simply hidden.
